faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this project?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Department of Nanotechnology, University of Kashmir, Srinagar.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name is Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application via email?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 16-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 19.10.2026 (Monday) at 2:30 PM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Department of Nanotechnology, CCPC, University of Kashmir.

faq.question: Q7. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Sc in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Nanotechnology, or allied subjects with a minimum of 55% marks. Candidates with NET/SET or GATE are preferred.

faq.question: Q8. What are the monthly emoluments for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The monthly emoluments are 20000 plus 18% HRA.

faq.question: Q9. Is the position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary, co-terminus with the end of the project, and subject to the release of funds.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates email their application files?
faq.answer: Candidates must email their statement of interest and documents as a single PDF file to [email protected].
